powerup.freeze.desc: Freezes enemies in the zone. Frozen enemies die if you pass through them.

powerup.trail.desc: You leave a lethal trail behind you for a few seconds.

powerup.dash.desc: A fast, invulnerable dash that kills what you pass through.
